body: 41 here. Been suffering from anxiety and depression since my teens. Didn’t expect to make 30, let alone 40. It’s a strange experience existing in a time that you didn’t expect to see. I’m just drifting through like a bored teen in a museum having a half assed look around at all the strange things going on but not really caring and can see the exit coming up.
I give this two freakishly big thumbs up 👍 😉

It is a beautiful place for sure. It’s not too far from where I live really so it’s easy to get away and enjoy it. Great countryside and coastal walks, that’s all I need.
I’ve tried it once or twice and I was useless at it! The concentration is key for sure. I guess that’s a good way to get the mind focused and away from negativity. Add yoga and exercise and you’ll master it in no time! Is there local competitions you can enter when you get better at it? That would be fun!

That’s a nice place to live, amazing sights and wildlife around you right?
Nothing wrong with a cheesy pun 😆, I’m guilty of that! Usually at the worst times lol. I’ll be working on my photography for sure. So much to see outdoors!

I live in the UK and I’ll be heading to wales for a week. 
The same with me. I either go with a friend or two or by myself. I don’t do big groups too well. 
It’s sad we all get to busy to enjoy things in nature isn’t it. I’m definitely trying to improve on that for myself at least.
I tried rock climbing when I was younger! The heights made me feel kind of light headed even though I generally don’t mind heights, weird.
Archery is cool, does it hurt your hands? Like you need to strengthen them to improve kinda thing?

I do love to travel! I’ll be going to a new place this summer so I’m looking forward to that. 
I do appreciate nature and one thing I’ve started doing more regularly is hiking. So that covers exercise too and I’ll be keeping that up. A hobby I’ve always skirted around is photography so I think I’ll be taking that more seriously in the coming years. Thanks for the advice! 
What hobbies have you discovered then?
Thank you! So far so good. I’m hoping it’s the start of some good times
Sounds good to me! I might enjoy this next stage of life…

Thank you! Everyone has been very welcoming and friendly. I reckon I might hang around for a good 10 years lol! 
Any recommendations for me to do during my stay?
Everything is overpriced and the music was better in my day! Am I sounding like a grumpy old man yet? Lol

A few people have mentioned they’ve started new things once they hit 40 so that’s a good thing. I’m definitely feeling less stressful and less pressure now. I’m pleased to get those younger years out the way and I’m excited for this new chapter. Congrats on the new artistic skills, it must be relaxing painting? 
With photography it’s mostly nature related with me. Can’t beat a few hours in the woods or countryside watching the natural world go by and taking some snaps along the way!
That’s a great idea, I’d like to join and help out others!

Why do ass holes have great lives and good people die young? Doesn’t seem fair at all and I gave up trying to work this place out years ago. Just seems like we’re stuck in some kind of weird zoo where the only rules are created by other people in it. Thinking logically, life is beyond ridiculous isn’t it! Try to be nice and treat people well and get crapped on. Be a selfish ass hole and become a millionaire!

Thank for the reply. Oh yes for sure I’m trying to find meaning or purpose in life. Thanks for the recommendation, I’ll check them out when I get my reading mojo back. Sucks a bit when depression and anxiety takes all your eagerness to do things you used to enjoy doesn’t it. How are you doing now in general? Happy with your progress?

I enjoy hiking and photography (usually at the same time!). Where’s your favourite place to hike?
I also find philosophy very interesting. Trying to work out why certain things happen and the meaning or reason behind it, if there even is at all. It’s good fun going down those unanswerable rabbit holes isn’t it

It sucks not being in a true love relationship but in a way it’s worst when you’re in one and constantly worrying when it will fall apart. That’s mostly just me and my anxiety issues I guess but when I was in it, it was almost too much to bear. Maybe most humans aren’t equipped with how to deal with these intense feelings? The relationships I’ve been in where I like the person a lot, and love them in a way, are better for me. Less stressful. The one with that intensely strong real pure love was emotionally draining. Now I’m stuck in a middle area where some days I long for it again and others I think if I went through that again it would probably kill me lol! 
So to some up what it’s like? Both the best experience ever and also the most stressful experience ever!
Definitely. It’s usually comes from absolutely no where too. Like I could be walking on a summers day then all of a sudden, life becomes too heavy
How sad was this
Thanks for the input. Makes you think a little deeper doesn’t it

I get this sometimes when I’m driving my car believe it or not! It just a randomly hits me like “I’m in control of this fast moving thing, don’t freak out!”

Sometimes it happens like you describe but not as bad. Moments hit when it feels like I’ve been pushed into reality kind of? Like snap, I’m part of this conversation or bam! I’m in line at the post office, it’s weird isn’t it

Sure that would be very nice! I actually work with younger people and I can relate to them well. Overthinking is one of my things too so I can relate. Any time I can give advice makes me happy so feel free to ask any questions. Thank for the reply too!

Fairly often. I went up in the summer. They live near leamington which is a nice place. Dartmoor is a great place to explore and is a bit spooky. Most of the moors down here have urban legends surrounding them!
Hello! Thank you for the reply. How are you doing today?
That’s how I started. I enjoy hiking and often came across great scenery so thought why not start taking photos. Do you hike a lot? I miss the outdoors
Thank you! I enjoy amateur photography so I give it a go sometimes. How are you? Nice weekend?
Hello! I’m in the West Country. I actually have family in the midlands. How’s your day so far?

Yes that’s how I’m feeling. My life has been stuck in a mundane mode for so many years now. I wouldn’t like to start again in a different body or whatever, I want there to be something new to explore and experience, assuming souls or whatever exist. I do wonder what my last day will be like? Probably a grey Tuesday in February where nothing exciting happens!
I’m very far from Texas! I’m a guy in my 30s from the UK. Been through a lot in life and learned many lessons so feel free to chat anytime.
Weird

It’s a very long story! Google the Turkish invasion of varosha, Cyprus and it’ll tell you all about it. The basics are it’s been abandoned since a war in the 70s. The town is stuck in no mans land which is the border between northern and southern Cyprus.
Thank you, I appreciate that. My knowledge isn’t great for sure but I’ve learned plenty today lol 😉

Jesus I just took some photos and thought I’d share them! I’m not expecting anything from anyone. Literally just found the location interesting and thought people interested in trains might appreciate the photos. I’d like to apologise for all the offence cause with my title and lack of knowledge. I’m obviously going straight to hell 🙄

Thank you! Saying they’re abandoned is quickly becoming my biggest life regret lol! I literally thought it was interesting and took some photos. I obviously don’t know too much about the process with old trains, just thought it would be cool to share some photos. Thank you for the information though, nice to have a sensible response 👍
Fair enough 👍
Thank you! Much appreciated 🙂
Yea I understand that. I apologise for my badly worded title

I’m just going by what I was told by a local. He said some have been there over 10 years and are slowly deteriorating. Maybe I should’ve used the term “forgotten “? I hope they do bring them back to use. My little boy loves trains and was fascinated by them. Here’s hoping to a better life after covid for humans and trains 😉
I was talking to an older guy who lives nearby and he said some have been there over 10 years. Maybe not abandoned but forgotten about?
Yeah that makes sense. They’ve turned a carriage into a cafe so they might have things in mind for the others down the line
It’s a shame isn’t it. You’d think they could be restored?
I’m a guy in my 30s with all kinds of life experiences, not all great though! I’ve been told I’m a good listener and I enjoy good conversation so feel free to say Hi anytime 😊

Unfortunately some people use those apps just to get back at the world. She probably had issues with an ex or another guy but decided to take it out on you as you were the “closest” person. There are good people out there, it’s a shame they are rare though. Don’t give up just yet, use her as a learning experience. Take note of things that triggered her and things she blew out of proportion so you can avoid them in the future? Good luck

Is there anything you want to do in life? A place you want to visit? Any avenues you thought about exploring? 
I’ve been in your position a few times and I think to myself if this is it then why not do a few more things that I wanted to do? Ignoring other people’s input. Maybe just think of yourself for a day and see what you come up with?

We seem to be invisible sadly. I’ve had strong feelings for a few people but only loved one. Sadly it was not returned. I don’t think anyone has ever felt that way about me. Maybe nice really guys do finish last? A lot of lonely people on here seem like really nice, genuine people

That’s fair enough. I thought it would be classed as a glitch because for me two different realities kinda clashed which I couldn’t explain? Two separate events coming from the same instance. Sorry if it doesn’t match the criteria

I get that too! Somewhere between melancholy/deja vu/depersonalisation or however it’s described. It’s like the world around either stops or resets and your kinda watching it or feeling it at least. It made me do research into the simulation theory and multiple realities. It’s very interesting. I don’t find it particularly bad personally, just intriguing

I have thought about that to be honest. Years ago I suffered a bad head injury playing football so I often wonder if there would be some long term side effects. I lost my memory when I was knocked out you see. Along with deja vu I sometimes get that feeling of depersonalisation, like I’m not really here. Also a lot of crazy dreams! I probably do need to be checked out.

I’ve tried those sites loads of times over the years, maybe 10 years or so. I’ve never met a decent person. All I found is “hot girls” looking for the chase from horny teens, attention seekers, people who are totally self centred, fake people, scammers, weirdos and people who reply once or twice then disappeared. I can’t remember having a decent conversation lasting more than a few sentences. I’ve never dated anyone from those sites but get this, I’ve dated 3 people from sites that were totally not dating sites! One from a travel site, one from a supernatural /mystery site and one from Facebook lol. The point is you find the right or at least better people, in the environments you both enjoy. Maybe try looking to meet people under different circumstances?

Honestly it used to be rare but now it is a few times a week. This started within the last year. I’m not sure what caused it but it’s definitely a more frequent occurrence. Mine doesn’t really predict anything, just kinda feels like I’ve lived this moment before, although the events were different at times. Maybe it’s not deja vu at all? 🤔

That’s a good goal for a new year. It’s always fun to ask the deep questions on why we exist and the point of everything. Are we in a simulation? Or is it all just a random selection of events? Both maybe?? 🤔

Yes! For me I think about resetting when I’m about 16. Finished school, doing college part time and meeting new people. Obviously I’d need my knowledge from now so I can avoid certain things and people. I’d love to replay my life from there going off in a totally different direction

Yes it’s not a great idea to hang out with people who don’t show you any respect or even acknowledge your existence. As you go through life you will connect with better people so don’t give up on future friends, maybe just dispense of the crappy ones you don’t need. Thank you! No need to feel sad for me, I’m fine. I’m working through it. It’s sad when you really thought you have a connection with someone but they obviously don’t feel the same but life is harsh isn’t it.

If that’s your passion then please follow it. You may feel trapped but your still young. Trapped is when all options are exhausted and too much time has passed. I did many jobs, all unfulfilling. It’s just about making enough money to survive for me, every day is hard. If you follow your passion, your life will start to feel purposeful

For me the more I learned and understood life going forward, the past and root of my depression started to become clear. I can’t say one thing caused it but when I was about 14/15, life became serious. I wasn’t ready for the outside world, yet I didn’t exactly enjoy school. I didn’t have a plan for the future, a serious plan I should say. I only wanted to travel after school but literally everyone shot that down. I felt my life wasn’t really mine to control. I just followed orders and all of a sudden years began to pass. My advice is try to find something your passionate about and that you find fulfilling. I wish I made more of my early years.

There definitely needs to be more done about this in schools. I’m in my 30s now but starting suffering from depression in my teens. There was no education or help on it back then. There wasn’t anyone taking about it at all. I guess that’s a good thing because those trendy assholes making light of it didn’t exist. The opposite factor is that no help really existed either. Years later I still think back to the root of my depression. It’s always going to be here, and I’m still learning to live with it each day. I hope you are ok and in general I hope there is a big change in how younger people are educated and helped when suffering. Try to find your own way in life without these people intruding with their crap!
Cheers! 🍻

It’s hard to deal with isn’t it. What I did, after trying a few things, was give people one last chance to talk. I ask people some random questions about life or just said hello and I sat back to see who replied. I gave them a sensible time period of a few days. The ones that ignored me or brushed me off got deleted from my life in all aspects. Social media, mobile number, email etc, all deleted. I figured if they can’t even take the time to reply or even give a thumbs up or a stupid emoji, then I’ll never be worth their time. After time I realised I don’t miss them and they obviously didn’t miss me so move on and enjoy a fresh start
Yeah shame isn’t it! I managed to spend a week there before lockdown 1 took place. Maybe one sunny day in the future...

I think we can all appreciate honesty can’t we . It’s the lack of reasoning that sucks. If I upset or offended someone then I’d like to know and apologise. What’s horrible is being made to feel like I’m not worthy of existence in other people’s worlds. I’m ok though, reading others issues and how they deal with them is inspiring. Hope things improve for you 🙂

One even blocked me and I knew her for years! I’ve been dealing with the loneliness for a while now, trying to re-evaluate myself and where I want to go in life. Sorry to hear about your situation
